run_local_graph: run a LocalRunner on a Graph with source, transform, and sink nodes connected via topics
run_parallel_graph: run a ParallelRunner on a distributed Graph with PubGroup and SubGroup modules
test_background_main: test that background and main decorated methods execute correctly on a Node
run_parallel_logging: run a ParallelRunner and verify HDF5 logging output for graph topics
run_single_process_parallel: run a ParallelRunner on a single-process Graph and verify message flow end to end
